title: Quick Stats
content: Build quick stats row for key metrics at a glance. Layout: flex row with equal-width items. Stat item: icon (optional), label (text-sm text-gray-500), value (text-2xl font-bold), change indicator. Change indicator: arrow icon, percentage, color (green/red). Sparkline: optional mini chart. Responsive: 2 columns on tablet, stack on mobile. Loading state: skeleton placeholders.

variants.simple: Create stats row showing key metrics with labels and values.
variants.detailed: Build quick stats row for key metrics at a glance. Layout: flex row with equal-width items. Stat item: icon (optional), label (text-sm text-gray-500), value (text-2xl font-bold), change indicator. Change indicator: arrow icon, percentage, color (green/red). Sparkline: optional mini chart. Responsive: 2 columns on tablet, stack on mobile. Loading state: skeleton placeholders.
variants.advanced: Build quick stats row for key metrics at a glance with comprehensive features. Layout: flex row (flex-wrap or grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) with equal-width items, gap-4 or gap-6, optional card backgrounds or dividers between items. Stat item structure: icon (optional, in w-10 h-10 rounded-full colored background circle, representing metric type), label (text-sm text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide), value (text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold, properly formatted - currency with symbol, percentages with %, numbers with commas), change indicator row below. Change indicator: flex items-center gap-1, ArrowUp (text-green-600) or ArrowDown (text-red-600) icon, percentage change (+12.3%), color matching direction, comparison period text in parentheses ("vs last week"). Sparkline: optional inline mini chart (60x20px) showing 7-day trend, simple SVG path or tiny line chart, helps visualize trend beyond single number. Variants: simple text (no backgrounds), with card backgrounds (bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-4), with vertical borders between items (divide-x), compact single-row. Click interaction: entire stat clickable, navigates to detailed view/report page. Loading state: skeleton placeholders matching layout (animate-pulse gray rectangles for value and label). Refresh button: optional RefreshCw icon button to manually refresh stats, loading state during refresh. Time range: selector dropdown or button group (Today, This Week, This Month, Custom) affecting all stats. Custom stat: "+" button to add custom tracked metric with configuration modal. Error state: show error icon with "Unable to load" message and retry. Real-time: optional live updates with subtle animation on change. Responsive: 2 columns on tablet (sm:grid-cols-2), stack to single column on mobile. Dark mode: dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-white. Accessibility: proper labeling, announce value changes with aria-live for real-time updates.
